```{r}
library(survey)
library(texreg)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

dir.create("Tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Cargar base de datos y crear variable post
panel_total <- read.csv("Intermediates/Panel_total.csv")
panel_total <- panel_total %>% mutate(post = ifelse(year >= 2022, 1, 0))

# Crear diseño muestral base
diseno_panel <- svydesign(
  ids = ~varunit_panel,
  strata = ~varstrat_panel,
  weights = ~expr_osig,
  data = panel_total,
  nest = TRUE
)

# Restringir por edad
diseno_panel <- diseno_panel %>% subset(edad <= 65)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# VARIABLES GLOBALES Y FUNCIÓN DE EXPORTACIÓN
# ---------------------------------------------------------
calcular_r2 <- function(modelo) {
  1 - (modelo$deviance / modelo$null.deviance)
}

nombres_col_personalizados <- c(
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}Hetero\\\\ (1)\\end{tabular}",
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}Hetero\\\\ (2)\\end{tabular}",
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}Lesbian/Gay\\\\ (3)\\end{tabular}",
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}Lesbian/Gay\\\\ (4)\\end{tabular}",
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}Bisexual\\\\ (5)\\end{tabular}",
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}Bisexual\\\\ (6)\\end{tabular}",
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}Cis\\\\ (7)\\end{tabular}",
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}Cis\\\\ (8)\\end{tabular}",
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}GM\\\\ (9)\\end{tabular}",
  "\\begin{tabular}[c]{@{}c@{}}GM\\\\ (10)\\end{tabular}"
)

controles_demo <- rep(c("NO", "YES"), 5)

exportar_tabla_latex <- function(lista_modelos, mapa_coef, archivo_salida, titulo) {
  valores_r2 <- as.numeric(sapply(lista_modelos, calcular_r2))
  filas_gof <- list("Demographic Controls" = controles_demo, "R$^2$" = valores_r2)
  
  tex_base <- texreg(lista_modelos, 
                     custom.model.names = nombres_col_personalizados, 
                     custom.coef.map = mapa_coef,
                     digits = 3,
                     include.dispersion = FALSE, include.deviance = FALSE,
                     include.aic = FALSE, include.bic = FALSE, include.loglik = FALSE,
                     custom.gof.rows = filas_gof, table = FALSE)
  
  lineas <- strsplit(tex_base, "\n")[[1]]
  
  # CORRECCIÓN: Tomar solo el primer inicio y el último final
  idx_begin <- grep("\\\\begin\\{tabular\\}", lineas)[1]
  idx_end <- tail(grep("\\\\end\\{tabular\\}", lineas), 1)
  
  tabular_body <- lineas[idx_begin:(idx_end-1)]
  
  tabla_final <- c(
    "\\begin{table}[htpb]",
    "\\label{tab:prob}",
    "\\centering",
    paste0("\\caption{", titulo, "}"),
    "\\resizebox{\\textwidth}{!}{",
    tabular_body,
    "\\hline",
    "\\multicolumn{11}{l}{\\scriptsize{$^{***}p<0.001$; $^{**}p<0.01$; $^{*}p<0.05$}} \\\\",
    "\\end{tabular}",
    "}",
    "\\vspace{1ex}",
    "\\raggedright",
    "\\footnotesize\\textit{Note:} According to the literature, the most relevant demographic controls for modeling membership in these groups include age, education, marital status, rural-urban residence, and variables of ethnic origin or immigrant status \\citep{Badgettetal2021, Carpenteretal2020}.",
    "\\end{table}"
  )
  writeLines(tabla_final, archivo_salida)
}
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# 1. MODELOS ORIGINALES: Variable POST
# =========================================================
Hetero_1P_INTER <- svyglm(Hetero ~ post * AFAB, design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())
Hetero_2P_INTER <- svyglm(Hetero ~ post * AFAB + edad + esc + factor(ecivil) + factor(area) + pueblos_indigenas + extranjero + men11c + factor(region), design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())

LG_1P_INTER <- svyglm(LG ~ post * AFAB, design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())
LG_2P_INTER <- svyglm(LG ~ post * AFAB + edad + esc + factor(ecivil) + factor(area) + pueblos_indigenas + extranjero + men11c + factor(region), design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())

Bi_1P_INTER <- svyglm(bisexual ~ post * AFAB, design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())
Bi_2P_INTER <- svyglm(bisexual ~ post * AFAB + edad + esc + factor(ecivil) + factor(area) + pueblos_indigenas + extranjero + men11c + factor(region), design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())

Cis_1P_INTER <- svyglm(cis ~ post * AFAB, design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())
Cis_2P_INTER <- svyglm(cis ~ post * AFAB + edad + esc + factor(ecivil) + factor(area) + pueblos_indigenas + extranjero + men11c + factor(region), design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())

GM_1P_INTER <- svyglm(GM ~ post * AFAB, design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())
GM_2P_INTER <- svyglm(GM ~ post * AFAB + edad + esc + factor(ecivil) + factor(area) + pueblos_indigenas + extranjero + men11c + factor(region), design = diseno_panel, family = quasibinomial())

lista_post <- list(Hetero_1P_INTER, Hetero_2P_INTER, LG_1P_INTER, LG_2P_INTER, Bi_1P_INTER, Bi_2P_INTER, Cis_1P_INTER, Cis_2P_INTER, GM_1P_INTER, GM_2P_INTER)

mapa_post <- list("post" = "Post", "AFAB" = "AFAB", "post:AFAB" = "Post $\\times$ AFAB")

exportar_tabla_latex(lista_post, mapa_post, "Tables/reg_q_post_inter_c.tex", "Discrete choice of Autodetermination (Post 2022)")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# EXPORTACIÓN DE LA TABLA COMPLETA (TODOS LOS CONTROLES)
# Base entera, variable POST (2022 y 2024)
# =========================================================

nombres_modelos_full <- c("Hetero", "Hetero", "LG", "LG", "Bisexual", "Bisexual", 
                          "Cis", "Cis", "GM", "GM")

# Extraemos todos los coeficientes que existen en los modelos
nombres_originales_inter <- unique(unlist(lapply(lista_post, function(x) names(coef(x)))))
mapa_coef_full <- setNames(as.list(nombres_originales_inter), nombres_originales_inter)

# Renombramos a etiquetas limpias para LaTeX
mapa_coef_full[["post"]]      <- "Post"
mapa_coef_full[["AFAB"]]      <- "AFAB"
mapa_coef_full[["post:AFAB"]] <- "Post $\\times$ AFAB"

mapa_coef_full[["(Intercept)"]]       <- "Constant"
mapa_coef_full[["edad"]]              <- "Age"
mapa_coef_full[["esc"]]               <- "Schooling years"
mapa_coef_full[["factor(ecivil)2"]]   <- "Partnered"
mapa_coef_full[["factor(ecivil)3"]]   <- "Engaged"
mapa_coef_full[["factor(ecivil)4"]]   <- "Annulled"
mapa_coef_full[["factor(ecivil)5"]]   <- "Separated"
mapa_coef_full[["factor(ecivil)6"]]   <- "Divorced"
mapa_coef_full[["factor(ecivil)7"]]   <- "Widowed"
mapa_coef_full[["factor(ecivil)8"]]   <- "Single"
mapa_coef_full[["factor(area)2"]]     <- "Rural"      
mapa_coef_full[["pueblos_indigenas"]] <- "Indigenous" 
mapa_coef_full[["extranjero"]]        <- "Immigrant"
mapa_coef_full[["men11c"]]            <- "Children<=11"

# Exportación de la tabla con TODOS los coeficientes mapeados
texreg(lista_post, 
       custom.model.names = nombres_modelos_full, 
       custom.coef.map = mapa_coef_full,
       digits = 3,
       caption.above = TRUE,
       table = FALSE, 
       file = "Tables/reg_q_post_inter_full.tex")
```
